# Contract check: the immediate-return remember

**Date:** 2026-04-06
**Participants:** Wynn Castellano (Staff Engineer)

Wynn: "We ratified the async job contract: remember returns a receipt in
seconds and the extraction is watched by polling a cursor. No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt."

Key decision: remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

positions.name: AsyncRememberJobContract
positions.frame: how does remember hand control back to the agent while extraction runs, and how does the agent come to see the outcome without blocking or losing work?
positions.why: Both segments describe the same ratified async job contract for remember. src-1 gives the contract: an immediate receipt, extraction watched by polling a cursor, no blocking call, and durable work if the client drops the receipt. src-2 records the decision on how the outcome is seen, either the agent polls the run or the reaction is piggybacked on a later call. They are one reading of how the immediate-return remember behaves. A mild tension is held, not resolved: src-1 names polling as the watching mechanism, while src-2 leaves piggybacking as an alternative to polling.

placements.title: Remember returns control at once while extraction runs on durable work
placements.frame: What does the agent get back the moment it asks to remember, and how does it come to see the extraction outcome without blocking or losing work?
placements.why: The position carries both the ratified contract (immediate receipt, cursor polling, no blocking call, no lost work) and the decision on how the outcome is seen (poll the run, or piggyback the reaction on a later call). This is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact. No existing leaf is in the graph, so it is minted standalone.
